categories.main_business_segments: XGIMI Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of smart projection products, including long-focus, ultra-short-focus, and innovative projection devices. The company also offers related accessories, internet value-added services, and is expanding into automotive optical solutions such as smart cockpits and intelligent headlights. Additionally, it operates in both domestic and international markets with a focus on consumer and commercial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical technologies including Dual Light 2.0 eye-protection tri-color laser, Eagle-Eye computational optics, and fully automatic gimbal systems. It has strong capabilities in optical engine design, precise heat dissipation, intelligent algorithms for auto-correction, auto-focus, and dynamic defocus compensation. Manufacturing involves a mix of in-house production, outsourcing, OEM, and ODM, with automated optical inspection and machine vision for quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: XGIMI serves primarily consumer markets with smart home entertainment products and is expanding into automotive sectors with smart cockpit and intelligent lighting solutions. Its customers include end consumers via e-commerce and offline retail channels, automotive manufacturers for in-vehicle projection systems, and commercial clients for business projection applications. The company also targets overseas markets including Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, with growing presence in overseas markets such as Europe, Japan, the United States, Southeast Asia, and Vietnam. It has subsidiaries and sales offices in multiple countries and regions, including Hong Kong, the US, Japan, Germany, Singapore, and Vietnam, supporting its global sales and production footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: XGIMI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, development, assembly, and sales. It controls key components like optical engines and mainboards through self-design and production, while sourcing other parts externally. The company also manages distribution channels and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes dual-driven innovation in foundational optical technologies and product development, investing heavily in R&D with collaborations with universities. Strategic priorities include enhancing optical architectures, expanding automotive projection solutions, developing commercial projection products, and global market expansion. It focuses on smart algorithms, hardware-software integration, and new application scenarios like automotive and commercial sectors.
categories.revenue_model: XGIMI generates revenue primarily through product sales of smart projectors and related accessories via online and offline channels. It also earns income from internet value-added services such as content streaming and application distribution, sharing revenue with content providers. Additionally, the company derives revenue from automotive optical solutions and commercial projection products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: XGIMI is a leading brand in the Chinese smart projection market, holding the top position in shipment volume and sales revenue for several consecutive years. It competes with domestic brands like Xiaomi, JmGO, and Fengmi, as well as international players such as Epson. The company differentiates itself through advanced optical technologies, comprehensive product lines, and strong global distribution networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, XGIMI reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.4 billion, a slight decline of 4.27% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders around RMB 120 million, nearly flat compared to the previous year. The company maintains a robust R&D investment ratio of about 10.8% of revenue. Overseas revenue showed growth, and the company continues to expand its market presence globally. Cash flow from operations decreased due to lower sales receipts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: XGIMI emphasizes superior user experience through innovative optical technologies that balance brightness, color accuracy, and eye protection. Its products feature intelligent functions like automatic correction, dynamic focus compensation, and fully automatic gimbals, enhancing ease of use. The company offers a diversified product matrix covering entry-level to high-end laser projectors and integrates smart software systems for content and application delivery, positioning itself as a technology leader in smart projection.
